id.instruksi: Data berjalan dari perangkat pengirim sampai ke penerima dan melewati router serta internet: susun langkah perjalanannya dari awal sampai akhir.
id.s1-2: laptop mengirim berkas lewat Wi-Fi ke router
id.s2-1: ibu memilih makanan lalu menekan Pesan
id.s2-2: HP ibu mengirim pesanan ke router rumah
id.s2-4: server aplikasi meneruskan pesanan ke warung
id.s3-2: HP mengirim lokasimu lewat Wi-Fi ke router
id.s3-4: server peta mengirim lokasi ke HP ayah
id.s3-5: peta di HP ayah menunjukkan titikmu
id.s4-2: bel mengirim video ke router rumah
id.s4-4: server bel pintu mengirim video ke HP ayah
id.s4-5: ayah melihat tamunya di layar HP
id.s5-2: jam mengirim data langkah lewat Wi-Fi ke router
id.s5-5: aplikasi di HP ibu menampilkan langkahmu
id.s6-1: kamu memilih stiker lalu menekan kirim
id.s6-2: HP mengirim stiker lewat Wi-Fi ke router
id.s6-4: server pesan mengirim stiker ke HP teman-teman
id.s7-2: video dikirim lewat internet ke server siaran
id.s7-3: server mengirim video dalam paket ke router rumahmu
id.s7-4: router meneruskan paket ke TV pintar
id.s7-5: TV menyusun paket lalu menayangkan pertandingan
id.s8-2: tablet mengirim jawabanmu ke router sekolah
id.s8-3: router sekolah meneruskan jawaban ke internet
id.s8-4: server kuis menghitung dan menyimpan nilaimu
id.s9-1: kamu mengisi formulir lalu menekan Kirim
id.s9-5: panitia melihat namamu di daftar peserta
id.s10-1: ibu menekan Nyalakan di aplikasi saat di kantor
id.s10-2: HP ibu mengirim perintah lewat internet
id.s10-4: router meneruskan perintah ke lampu teras
id.s11-1: kamu menekan Pinjam pada buku cerita
id.s11-2: tablet mengirim permintaan lewat Wi-Fi ke router
id.s11-4: server perpustakaan mengirim buku dalam paket-paket
id.s11-5: tablet menyusun paket lalu membuka bukunya

en.instruksi: Data travels from the sending device to the receiver, passing a router and the internet: put the steps of its trip in order from start to finish.
en.s1-1: you press Upload on your homework
en.s1-2: the laptop sends the file over Wi-Fi to the router
en.s1-3: the router passes the file on to the internet
en.s1-4: the online class server stores your homework
en.s1-5: the teacher opens your homework on their laptop
en.s2-1: Mum picks the food and presses Order
en.s2-2: Mum's phone sends the order to the home router
en.s2-3: the router sends the order on through the internet
en.s2-4: the app server forwards the order to the food stall
en.s2-5: the seller's phone shows Mum's order
en.s3-2: the phone sends your location over Wi-Fi to the router
en.s3-3: the router passes the location on to the internet
en.s3-4: the map server sends the location to Dad's phone
en.s3-5: the map on Dad's phone shows your dot
en.s4-1: a visitor presses the video doorbell
en.s4-2: the doorbell sends video to the home router
en.s4-3: the router passes the video on to the internet
en.s4-4: the doorbell server sends the video to Dad's phone
en.s4-5: Dad sees the visitor on his phone screen
en.s5-2: the watch sends the step data over Wi-Fi to the router
en.s5-3: the router passes the data on to the internet
en.s5-4: the health server stores your step count
en.s5-5: the app on Mum's phone shows your steps
en.s6: A sticker for the class group
en.s6-1: you choose a sticker and press send
en.s6-2: the phone sends the sticker over Wi-Fi to the router
en.s6-3: the router passes the sticker on to the internet
en.s6-4: the message server sends the sticker to your friends' phones
en.s6-5: the sticker appears in the class group
en.s7-1: the camera at the stadium films the match
en.s7-2: the video is sent through the internet to the broadcast server
en.s7-3: the server sends the video in packets to your home router
en.s7-4: the router passes the packets to the smart TV
en.s7-5: the TV puts the packets back together and shows the match
en.s8-1: you press Finish on the quiz
en.s8-2: the tablet sends your answers to the school router
en.s8-3: the school router passes the answers on to the internet
en.s8-4: the quiz server works out and stores your score
en.s8-5: your score appears on the teacher's screen
en.s9: Signing up for a drawing contest
en.s9-1: you fill in the form and press Send
en.s9-2: the laptop sends the form to the router
en.s9-3: the router passes the form on to the internet
en.s9-4: the organisers' server stores your sign-up
en.s9-5: the organisers see your name on the entry list
en.s10: Turning on a light from far away
en.s10-1: Mum presses Turn On in the app while at work
en.s10-2: Mum's phone sends the command through the internet
en.s10-3: the command reaches the home router
en.s10-4: the router passes the command to the porch light
en.s11-1: you press Borrow on a storybook
en.s11-2: the tablet sends the request over Wi-Fi to the router
en.s11-3: the router passes the request on to the internet
en.s11-4: the library server sends the book in packets
en.s11-5: the tablet puts the packets together and opens the book

steps.keterangan: jumlah tahap yang disusun; 4 berhenti sebelum penerima menampilkan hasil
